course_description: Comprehensive study of modern client-server web architectures, responsive frontend development (HTML5/CSS3/JavaScript), RESTful API engineering, backend services, database persistence, web security vulnerabilities, and cloud deployment.

course_outcomes.co_description: Implement modern, accessible responsive web user interfaces using HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript.
Develop scalable asynchronous frontend applications leveraging component state and API integration.
Analyze client-server architectures, HTTP protocols, RESTful API conventions, and JSON serialization.
Evaluate web security vulnerabilities including XSS, CSRF, and SQL Injection using security audits.
Design and deploy full-stack database-driven web applications integrating secure authentication and cloud hosting.

weekly_schedule.topic: Web Architecture, Client-Server Model, HTTP Protocols, and Tooling
weekly_schedule.teaching_learning_activity: Interactive Lecture and VSCode Web Extension Setup

lesson_outcomes.description: Explain request-response lifecycles, DNS resolution, and HTTP headers
Configure modern web developer tools, Git, and live servers
Appreciate web standards set forth by the W3C

weekly_schedule.topic: Semantic HTML5 Elements, Document Outlines, and Web Accessibility (a11y)

lesson_outcomes.description: Identify semantic markup tags (header, nav, main, section, footer)
Build accessible form controls and ARIA attributes for screen readers
Value inclusivity and accessibility for diverse user groups

weekly_schedule.topic: Modern CSS3: Box Model, Flexbox Layouts, and CSS Grid Systems

lesson_outcomes.description: Contrast block, inline, flex, and grid CSS formatting models
Implement responsive flexbox navigation and grid content cards
Strive for aesthetic balance and clean typographic hierarchy

weekly_schedule.topic: Responsive Web Design: Mobile-First Strategy and Media Queries

lesson_outcomes.description: Explain viewport configurations, responsive breakpoints, and REM units
Construct responsive layouts adapting fluidly to mobile and desktop
Demonstrate empathy for mobile users with limited bandwidth

weekly_schedule.topic: Core JavaScript: ES6+ Syntax, DOM Manipulation, and Event Handling

lesson_outcomes.description: Describe closures, arrow functions, destructuring, and event bubbling
Write JavaScript manipulating the DOM in response to user events
Display diligence when validating user inputs on the frontend

weekly_schedule.topic: Preliminary Examination: Frontend Architecture and Responsive Design Exam

lesson_outcomes.description: Recall HTTP response codes, CSS layout algorithms, and DOM hierarchy
Code a timed responsive web interface from design mockups
Exhibit professionalism and academic honesty under timed assessment

weekly_schedule.topic: Asynchronous JavaScript: Promises, Async/Await, and Fetch API

lesson_outcomes.description: Explain single-threaded event loops, call stacks, and callback queues
Fetch and parse remote JSON payloads using async/await patterns
Value graceful error handling during network latencies

weekly_schedule.topic: Frontend Framework Concepts: Component-Based Architecture and Virtual DOM

lesson_outcomes.description: Differentiate imperative DOM manipulation versus declarative components
Construct reusable UI components passing dynamic properties (props)
Commit to modular, reusable software architecture

weekly_schedule.topic: Component State Management, Lifecycle Hooks, and Forms

lesson_outcomes.description: Explain unidirectional data flow and reactive state mutation rules
Manage local component state and handle controlled form inputs
Appreciate immediate feedback loops in user interfaces

weekly_schedule.topic: Backend Engineering: Node.js/Python Servers and RESTful Route Handlers

lesson_outcomes.description: Define REST architectural constraints, idempotency, and URI schemes
Build HTTP GET, POST, PUT, DELETE routes handling JSON requests
Emphasize clean API documentation and uniform route naming

weekly_schedule.topic: Database Integration: Connecting Web Servers to Relational/NoSQL Stores

lesson_outcomes.description: Contrast SQL relational queries with document collection paradigms
Perform CRUD database operations through server-side connection pools
Value ACID transactions and data consistency in web stores

weekly_schedule.topic: Midterm Examination: Full-Stack API Integration Practical Exam

lesson_outcomes.description: Synthesize asynchronous frontend requests and backend API controllers
Deploy and test integrated client-server data flows under inspection
Demonstrate technical competence under formal assessment

weekly_schedule.topic: Web Security Essentials: OWASP Top 10, Cross-Site Scripting (XSS), and CSRF

lesson_outcomes.description: Explain XSS vectors, CSRF tokens, and Content Security Policies (CSP)
Audit and patch vulnerable client-side input reflection points
Uphold ethical responsibility in safeguarding user privacy

weekly_schedule.topic: Authentication & Authorization: Password Hashing, JWT, and Sessions

lesson_outcomes.description: Describe cryptographic salting, bcrypt hashing, and JWT signatures
Implement secure login routes issuing signed JSON Web Tokens
Commit to zero plain-text credential persistence in databases

weekly_schedule.topic: SQL Injection Prevention and Server-Side Input Sanitization

lesson_outcomes.description: Analyze raw query vulnerabilities versus parameterized statements
Refactor vulnerable database queries to use prepared parameters
Demonstrate vigilance in defensive coding practices

weekly_schedule.topic: Web Performance Optimization: Asset Minification, Caching, and CDN

lesson_outcomes.description: Explain browser caching headers, gzip compression, and tree-shaking
Profile website performance using Chrome Lighthouse and optimize assets
Strive for excellence in sub-second page loading speeds

weekly_schedule.topic: Full-Stack Deployment: Containerization, CI/CD, and Cloud Hosting

lesson_outcomes.description: Outline environmental variables, production builds, and continuous delivery
Deploy full-stack web applications to live cloud hosting environments
Practice constructive team coordination during release cycles

weekly_schedule.topic: Final Examination & Capstone Defense: Enterprise Web Solution Showcase

lesson_outcomes.description: Synthesize all frontend, backend, security, and deployment domains
Present and defend a live, responsive full-stack web application
Exemplify Perpetualite leadership and professional presentation ethics
